findings.title: Migration crashes on fresh or unconfigured databases when querying site_settings
findings.body: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, lines 9-11 and line 15 index `[0]` directly on the PG::Result returned by `execute(...)`. On a fresh database or any installation where `embed_category` (or `uncategorized_category_id`) has never been saved to the `site_settings` table, the query returns 0 rows (`cmd_tuples == 0`), so `[0]` evaluates to `nil` and `[0]['id']` / `[0]['value']` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method '[]' for nil:NilClass`, aborting `rake db:migrate`. Additionally, line 25 interpolates `#{h}` directly into the `INSERT` SQL without sanitizing or stripping `http(s)://` and paths (unlike `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation`), which will fail if a host contains a single quote or leave unnormalized hosts in the table.

findings.title: `before_validation` raises NoMethodError when `host` is nil
findings.body: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb` lines 6-7, the `before_validation` callback calls `self.host.sub!(...)` unconditionally. If `EmbeddableHost.new` is validated or saved with `host: nil` (for example via a malformed API request to `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`), `self.host` is `nil` and calling `.sub!` raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` instead of failing validation cleanly.

findings.title: `record_for_host` fails to match uppercase referer hostnames or configured ports
findings.body: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb` line 17, `record_for_host` queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` where `host = uri.host`. Because Ruby's `URI.parse` preserves the case of the hostname, an incoming URL with uppercase characters in the host (e.g., `http://Example.com/post`) will compare `lower(host)` against `'Example.com'` and fail to match (`host.downcase` is needed). Furthermore, the format validator on line 2 explicitly allows a port in `EmbeddableHost#host` (e.g. `localhost:3000`), and `before_validation` does not strip ports, yet `uri.host` excludes the port, so any `EmbeddableHost` saved with a port will never match in `record_for_host`.

findings.title: Contents of `category_fabricator.rb` and `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten to define `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while the newly added `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the `:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, and `:private_category` fabricators. The two files have their contents swapped.

findings.title: Misleading spec description in `expandable_first_post?` after removing `embeddable_hosts` check
findings.body: In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb` lines 1403-1405, the spec `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` only passes because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` defaults to `false` and `topic.has_topic_embed?` is `false` on a new `Topic`. `Topic#expandable_first_post?` no longer checks `EmbeddableHost` at all, so this test and the surrounding `describe 'with an emeddable host'` block no longer test what their descriptions claim.
